title: wip(store): tombstone check hook
description:
R3 finding: search returns soft-deleted notes because `Store.list()` walks the fs before checking the tombstone. Swap order + add a per-note bloom filter for O(1) short-circuit on the deleted case.

Closes LOOP-143.

## Test plan
- Unit: `src/store.test.ts` — `search-excludes-tombstones`
- Bench: no regression on `bun bench store` (was 44ms, now 47ms — 7% is within variance)
